owner: PV Backoffice GmbH / Green Power Park Lobstädt GmbH
notes: Combination of data center, green hydrogen production and battery storage powered by an ~85 ha solar field on former open-cast mine land; citizens' initiatives (Bürgerentscheide) failed 2025 so the park may proceed; building-rights procedure (Baurechtsverfahren) underway.
